title: Last time's numbers differ between logging a workout and editing it later
what: While logging a workout, the PREVIOUS column skips easy-week workouts and turns last time's weight into the card's counting (kg each or as one). When the member later opens the same workout to edit it, PREVIOUS uses a second rule: it can quote an easy-week workout and shows last time's weight as it was stored, without changing the counting. The same exercise on the same workout can show two different 'last time' numbers.
expected: Logging and editing a workout show the same PREVIOUS numbers: easy weeks left out and the weight in the card's counting both times.
who: members who follow a plan with easy weeks or switch kg each and as one
how_often: every edit of a workout after an easy week or a counting change
fix_line: Read PREVIOUS in the editor with the same rule as the live workout: skip easy weeks and convert to the card's counting

title: If the counting rule cannot be read, History and the coach quietly show a different kg lifted
what: The workout list read gives each workout a plain weight times reps total. Other screens then work it out again by the proper rule (body weight on pull-ups, dumbbells counted as each). If that second step fails, the History list and the coach's recent-workouts answer quietly keep the plain total, so the same workout shows a different kg lifted there than on the finish screen and Progress, with no word.
expected: Every screen shows the same kg lifted for a workout, or says the number could not be worked out.
who: members who log pull-ups, dips or dumbbell lifts
how_often: rare, only when the rule read fails
fix_line: Drop the quiet fallback to the plain total, or mark the number as not worked out

title: An exercise's 'Last' day can point at a workout its History tab does not list
what: The Exercises list's 'Last: 12 Oct' and the Recent band count every set, warm-ups included. The exercise page's History tab lists only workouts with real working sets. If the newest time an exercise was done had only warm-up sets, the list says one day and the History tab's newest row shows an older day.
expected: 'Last' and the History tab agree on the newest workout of an exercise.
fix_line: Leave warm-up sets out of the 'Last' day, as History does
